ops.title: Language-cache clock/namespace: no existing Python boot/host identity helper exists (only Go internal/hookd/proc_linux.go readBootTime; workers get just CAPT_HOOK_WORKER_ROOT/SHARD). Which should the worker implement?
ops.body:
B: monotonic + boot id (Recommended)
Options: B: monotonic + boot id (Recommended) | A: keep wall clock | C: Go daemon generation
Preview: key   = state/hooks/language-markers/<capt-hook version>/<boot id>/<project_key(root)>.json
age   = time.monotonic() - computed_at   (same clock, all processes, one boot)
expiry= age >= 30s  (identical to StampedCache)
boot  = new boot id -> new namespace, old entries never read
floor = request start (monotonic) for fresh builds
cost  : +1 small helper (sysctl / /proc read), +1 test
